images.title: Plus two from the Food Court
images.purpose: Show that starting on floor +1 and moving +2 reaches floor +3, because starting floor plus movement gives the target floor.
images.composition: One vertical column of floor marks centred, with one tall arrow on the right and one equation centred below.
images.exact_structure: One vertical grey #6B7280 line with 3 equally spaced dots marked from bottom to top +1, +2, +3 (3 dots only). The bottom dot +1 is teal #0072B2, the top dot +3 is reddish purple #CC79A7, the middle dot is plain. One teal arrow beside the line runs from the bottom dot up to the top dot, 2 steps. Below, centred, the equation line. Exactly 3 dots, 1 arrow, 1 equation.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any extra floor, dot, arrow or row beyond the counts stated
unequal floor rows or unequal arrow lengths
images.takeaway: Starting floor plus movement gives the target floor.
images.description: A vertical line with dots at +1 (Food Court), +2 and +3 (Book Store), a teal arrow of 2 steps going up, and the equation (+1) + (+2) = +3 below.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to point at the start, follow the arrow of 2 steps, and say where it lands.

image_decisions.why: Moving from the start floor along the arrow is a picture idea; one clean image carries it.
